reviews.title: Flight was overall good.
reviews.text: Tickets were originally purchased from AirBerlin, but actual flight was done by Niki. Flight was on time, overall it was what you would expect from Economy flight in the good sense for traveller.
reviews.author: Pessoft

reviews.title: Never any issues with Niki or Air berlin
reviews.text: They were always on time, cheap and the staff was friendly, but sadly they are not operating anymore.
reviews.author: Laura

reviews.title: Niki was good
reviews.text: Flight was on time. Very friendly staff. Good service for this short flight time. Today is not so much service with the airlines as before. I was a flight attendant myself. But Niki was great. I also thought Niki's uniform was cool.
reviews.author: Peggolita

reviews.title: Cancelled reservation
reviews.text: I bought a return ticket from Vienna to Tenerife with them for December 2017 - January 2018. unfortunately the ticket was cancelled just 2 days prior to my departure, without any explanation. Really bad luck and experience and my money gone!
reviews.author: Filip B

reviews.title: A pity for the Mallorca flights....
reviews.text: I was rebooked from an Air Berlin flight as Air Berlin was bankrupt, but except for the fact that the times for the flight were changed like 100000 times (something I don't blame them for), it was a great experience. Very friendly, enough legroom, just ok. A pity they are now bankrupt too...
reviews.author: Silvita

reviews.title: Do not book with them, they steal to the users
reviews.text: I booked a flight with a travel agency from Internet. Not option to add the two bags. I tried to add the luggage from their website, the page did not have the option to pay...it was 35 e each bag. I sent a mail to them, no reply. I tried to phone them , no reply. I phoned to the travel agency and they could not add the bag. The day of the flight I had to pay 130 swiss frank ( around 130$) for each luggage. The flight cost almost the double with the luggage. Good trick not to give the option to add the luggage and charged at the airport 130$. This is an abuse by the company. I will not flight never with them.
reviews.author: sandrafun2017

reviews.title: Insolvent from 14 dec 2017
reviews.text: Booked flight from 22dec-31dec 2017, Berlin Palma and for our suprise googled fly niki and seen is insolvent from tommorow 14 dec 2017. Incredible, what to do next?
reviews.author: Clauzone

reviews.title: An excellent experience with helpful smiling staff.
reviews.text: We used this service to return to the UK via Dusseldorf then BA into London City Airport. We had a really poor experience with BA so used Niki on this route and were very impressed with the efficiency and welcoming crew. The only downsides were the long wait at Dusseldorf for the luggage and the fact that all hot food had already run out before the steward reached our row of seating.
reviews.author: Christine T

reviews.title: Good surprise
reviews.text: Good surprise, the seat in economy has been comfortable and service being friendly. Originally we booked through another airline, the plane still had the Air Berlin logos and introduction videos but operated by NIKI . All the expectations about holiday airlines being positively surprised.
reviews.author: 970guenterk

reviews.title: small charter plane with low cost but extra comfort.
reviews.text: low cost Austrian airlines managed by Ethihad airways, extra comfort as compared to other low cost airlines. it offers many free snacks on board, also have wifi on board.upgraded airlines with best for what u pay.
reviews.author: Santosh Devraya K

reviews.title: Strait forward, low cost, low fare, good experience.
reviews.text: It was my first time booking a flight with Niki (flight was operated by airberlin). Must admit that it was a very good flight. Online ticket booking and checking in was strait forward with not complications or hidden fees. Same applies for boarding out of Zurich, very efficient even being on a remote stand. Crew was nice and polite even at 6am. Can't comment much on the service as I slept all flight long. As expected in a low cost, seats were not comfortable and there was no in-flight entertainment.
reviews.author: Dani S
reviews.route: Zurich - Las Palmas de Gran Canaria

reviews.title: Good airliner
reviews.text: Niki air is part of Airberlin, the service on board was OK, the boarding was very efficient and fast. Leg space was also OK.
reviews.author: Han6049

reviews.title: good experience.
reviews.text: very friendly crew, flew from zurich to teneriffe. had 30min delay on the way there but very punctual on the way back. would recommend it. no food included but can be bought on the place.
reviews.author: Selina E

reviews.title: Better than others
reviews.text: Looking back, the service has been reduced in the Air Berlin group. Since they know that they have financial problems they have stopped free food and reduced the newspapers. For people like me, who travel a lot, food and newspaper are not of big importance. More important is how friendly the staff is, how you sit and how comfortable the flight is. In these categories Niki is quite good. I personally hope that they survive the current crisis.
reviews.author: 989maz

reviews.title: Good flight
reviews.text: Very good flight. The seats were comfortable. It was relaxed and good flight and boarding was efficient.
reviews.author: Legend

reviews.title: An uneventful flight and that's a good thing when traveling on airlines!
reviews.text: After the disappointments with Air Berlin over recent years of traveling to and from Mallorca, the July flights this year were a welcome change and checking-in was quick, uncomplicated and very friendly. Maybe a few of Europe's major airlines could take a leaf out of NIKI's book...and learn something.
reviews.author: Rob C

reviews.title: poor service
reviews.text: poor service - no newpapers - very poor free food - extra pay for beverages - no informations about the route during the flight
reviews.author: roland721

reviews.title: good service
reviews.text: fligth left basel on time, good boarding and chack in, friendly staff Landed on time and services in Palma very good
reviews.author: hagar2086

reviews.title: Awful Airline
reviews.text: Niki Air has very bad customer service had to pay 90€ for one luggage one way trip, we had three luggage and we ended up paying 540 euros in total to travel from Vienna to Palma and back, while the initial flight tickets costed 245€ per person. So an additional 75% of the original ticket cost was added onto the price so we payed 425€ per person from Vienna to Palma and back. Never flying again with this airline, the tickets per person almost cost as much as an airline ticket overseas, and this was a 2hr charter flight in Europe, no wonder they are going out of business, ruined the entire family's vacation.
reviews.author: Andrej M

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: This was a code shared flight between Air Berlin and Niki, operated by Niki. The flight was on time, the cabin was clean, the crew were very helpful and the captain very informative.
reviews.author: Global_Citizen_YK

reviews.title: pleasant trip
reviews.text: Very pleasant trip with helpful staff, they offer good service, nice snacks. We could choose our seats, I felt safe.
reviews.author: kamaRadka

reviews.title: Poor indeed
reviews.text: Nearly one hour delay, four hour flight without catering (instead of paying extra for it). Friendly crew (Air Berlin-Aircraft). No on-flight-information, baggage service in Funchal and back in Berlin ok.
reviews.author: x0658

reviews.title: Short trip, nice treatment
reviews.text: I went to Vienna booking this flight with Niki through Alitalia. It was a nice flight, the plane was stable even if there were a lot of clouds and i spent the whole trip looking at the wing (i do like it). Then i also got (for free) a drink and a sandwitch, and it tasted really good. Would do again.
reviews.author: Flavio D

reviews.title: Very bad service with uncomfortable seats
reviews.text: Very uncomfortable seats (even though it was a short flight it was a real inconvenience. The food was overpriced over nothing and the service was average. In ) the flight was delayed and it took them a while to open the gate (I don't know if it was a problem in flight conditions however other flights to the same destination where not delayed) Not a great experience.
reviews.author: reem i

reviews.title: We were ripped off!
reviews.text: When I booked this flight on Expedia i did not see anywhere that I bought a ticket for an airline without the ability to have luggage! when I checked in online and tried to find everywhere a place to select checked-in luggage but was not able to find any option to add or as some low cost carriers do these days pay for the number of piece you are checking in. At the airport I was shocked that the check-in staff said that you don't have option for checked-in luggage! I told her that I didn't see anywhere that I just a ticket to board a plane without luggage. To my surprise later a found hidden in a very small text that this ticket doe not include and checked-in luggage. The airline NIKI charged us 60 Euro per bag! it was a rip-off of the highest type and kind. with 5 suitcases you can do the math. So how did this make me feel? I guess you can imagine. NEVER AGAIN FOR AS LONG AS I AM ALIVE TO TAKE NIKI.
reviews.author: Basim S

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: First time I flew with Niki actually I never heard of them before. Priced right ,clean, friendly crew, speak English...
reviews.author: Kathy O

reviews.title: Quite suspicious before depart but got a great surprise!
reviews.text: Got such a great service; aircraft in good conditions and some Good food to buy. Chocolate Muffins are amazing.. Got on time flights both ways..
reviews.author: ALBERTO T

reviews.title: Dreadful.
reviews.text: Our flight was delayed for over 4 hours with no airport service at all (the airport was already closed for the night) and no airline attendant to be found. They later denied any compensation claiming they "missed their time slot" and could not take off late at night. The flight the very next morning was dreadful, as it was obviously overbooked and people were sitting in the flight attendants' strap seats.
reviews.author: TheShis

reviews.title: Very good with good price
reviews.text: I booked to go from Malaga to Vienna, the timing was good and the service too. The boarding started very late which caused a big row of passengers waiting.
reviews.author: Ahmed AlAzrak

reviews.title: Was Good Until...
reviews.text: Non-stop to Palma, free check-in bags on the way there, would have given the flight a 5 star rating. Unfortunately, on the way back, the airline informed us there was a $90 charge for each bag to check in! Lucky for us, 3 of our bags were small enough to fit in the overhead otherwise would have been an extra $360! Completely negates the "shopping around" of flights!
reviews.author: Claudia G

reviews.title: Not impressed!
reviews.text: Despite being 2 hours earlier for check in was a terrible rush, not enough check in counters and went straight through to boarding. The plane missed its slot and was then delayed. Both there and back, the pilot gave only a short talk at the beginning. Bad turbulence on the way back, such that some passengers were ill, and yet no reasurance from the pilot that everything was OK. At one point, ALL the lights went out, very alarming and yet again no comment from the staff.
reviews.author: Frances L

reviews.title: Surprisingly Good
reviews.text: First time w/ Niki and by default as ticket was booked via American Airlines miles. Have heard mixed reviews and was hesitant initially...but it's a reward ticket and could not change carriers. Shockingly very good airline despite the negative reviews we've seen, great crew and service was above most domestic US carriers. Knowing you pay for most everything on board, we weren't caught off guard. Only negative marks are the check-in counter at Funchal. We were 3 hours early, I realize now that's nearly 90 minutes too early by Euro standards. The counters did not open until 1 hour before boarding, despite the queue being over 150 people long at 2 hour mark. TUI agents were just as shocked as we were, line wrapped around twice. When counters did open, all form of lines were disseminated and it was every pax for themselves. On plus side, ticketing agent was very apologetic and managed to check our bags through to PHL for customs check. Despite an overnight in Munich Niki took care of our bags and quickly won favor back. For US comparison, I would rate Niki above United but below Alaskan. Overall impressed and very good flight from start to finish.
reviews.author: Vagabond VanHams

reviews.title: HG2823 Charter
reviews.text: brand new A321; nice and attentive crew but everything on board has to be paid; they did not even offer some water; in comparison to other charter flights a big minus; entertainment options (against payment) good;
reviews.author: Elmar W

reviews.title: Like a bad bus
reviews.text: First time with this airline and never again. The stewardess in jeans no drinks no food everything just paying money for it. The toiletts horrible......Service on bord nothing....not clean.
reviews.author: Timmi92

reviews.title: good airline - arrived late
reviews.text: highly professional service and staff, friendly on board. however the flight left 40 minutes late and hence we arrived late at our destination. we were very tight with the time as we had an appointment once we landed. however, everything else was fine
reviews.author: DalliW1

reviews.title: NikiAir Review
reviews.text: NikiAir is a sub partner of AirBerlin and I must say there service is way better than AirBerlin's. On the other hand there is only about 3 fingers worth of legroom and the food service is very fast. If you don't notice them coming past you won't have the opportunity to buy anything. Furthermore they are super strict with hand luggage. Overall service is better than AirBerlin but is very bad compared to Lufthansa Regional, Germania or Germanwings.
reviews.author: fefischer0808

reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.text: That was the worst flight in a long time. They changed the plane, so we didn't get the seats we had reserved and paid for. I do not know when the decision to change the plane was made, but we did not receive any notification. As a result of this change, we did not sit next to each other. The flight attendants were of no help, matter of fact they were very rude. No wonder this airline is having problems. If I can somehow avoid them, I will never set foot in one of their planes again. Not a good way to start a vacation!
reviews.author: Tim F
reviews.route: Munich - Las Palmas de Gran Canaria

reviews.title: very good no frills flight
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised in that this is a no frills airline operated by air berlin. the entire trip went well and I would definitely recommend this airline to others. very convenient to fly to my destination without stopping in Athens.kudos to air berlin and niki for offering this flight
reviews.author: happpy67

reviews.title: Not so reliable!
reviews.text: Flight was cancelled and despite the fact they knew this ahead of time did not bother to email or call or send a text which these days most airlines do to keep their customers updated of the status of flight. Very unfriendly airport and cabin staff, Air Berlin and HSA ground crew handling their affairs and seem they care less about this airline. I have to give them this thought they had our re routed tickets ready before we even get into airport I gave them this that even Lufthansa does not provide that.
reviews.author: campione838

reviews.title: not really impressive
reviews.text: the stuff did not know about my booked place, they even did not know and were not prepared for me (am a disabled person), the reaction on my needs was not very nice..... the flight itself ok, but the refreshment pretty poor - compare with Austrian very poor
reviews.author: Danka P

reviews.title: Another airline with poor customer service and unclear costly baggage fees
reviews.text: As a musician I travel across Europe over 30 times a year. I'm pretty tired of bad customer service, and sneaky baggage fees. I booked a oneway flight 5 days prior to departure. Not having hours to deal with navigating a bad website, I failed to book extra baggage on this flight after about an hour of working it. I tried again the next day and had the same outcome. The night before my flight it finally worked, this time with a charge of 65 EUR for a checked bag. I complained at check in and Swissport was sympathetic but said Air Berlin doesn't move in their policy and I ended up paying an extra 120 for two bags. It's a lot of unexpected cash to dish out for a traveling musician...The nice people at the Greek Swissport on Kos said that their flight was nearly delayed because so many people on that flight had to pay extra fees for their baggage. They were also frustrated. I called up Air Berlin and after 30 mins on hold they did absolutely nothing. So here you go Air Berlin. This was my experience. I would put Niki and Air Berlin in the same category as Ryan Air, who already has their infamous reputation. A shameless and sneaky ripoff.
reviews.author: dwallmail

reviews.title: Bad experience before upcoming trip
reviews.text: ATTENTION: Do NOT give your business to Nikki/Airberlin or Lufthansa! We paid extra to book a direct/non-stop flight from Salzburg at 11:05 and arriving Palma de Mallorca at 1:10. However, we just received a notice that our flight changed and is now leaving Salzburg at 5:35 and arriving Palma de Mallorca at 7:40 which defeats our purpose and disrupts our itinerary. I called Nikki/Airbelin at (917) 261-3165 for an explanation, but never had the chance to speak with a customer service representative even after being on hold for 23.06 minutes. I’ve been experiencing similar issues with Lufthansa for the other leg of our trip. In fact, on February 8, 2017 I wrote to Lufthansa regarding the pending matter and, to date, have not received a response. If this is a reflection of Nikki/Airberlin and Lufthansa standard of business for North Americans, I am very concerned about our upcoming trip. I never expected this lack of service from Austrian/German operated airlines and am very disappointed
reviews.author: Wanderlust

reviews.title: Nothing special.
reviews.text: We booked a flight with Air Berlin. We were surprised on the airport that we had to fly with Niki. I didn't know the airline, nobody mentioned us the switch before. The flight was on time. The crew is not that professional, slow service. The plane itself was one from Air Berlin. The plane was very hot inside and there was limited space to sit.
reviews.author: NoeB1
reviews.route: Santa Cruz de la Palma - Düsseldorf

reviews.title: Niki airberlin, Niki .... se on kamala
reviews.text: Three days prior to travel, the flight time changed and the airline Air Berlin to Niki and, however, were flown to Air Berlin's machine. Flights delayed 3.5 hours on the outward journey and the return journey and 14 hours. On the way back for some reason between the flight were informed that the machine does not lower Tegel the airport, but the airport which goes is Schoneveld and bus shuttle to Tegel Airport 01.30 at night and 14 hours late. Just awful never at the airline in the future ! if someone wants an easy life as not worth traveling to Niki Airlines and Air Berlin.
reviews.author: aplmikkeli

reviews.title: Local low cost airline doing a great job - Best landing ever.
reviews.text: Low cost airline (One World Group) Does the job very well. Crew is nice, you get free food. I travel frequently by plane and the landing I have experienced on flight PG710 between MDL and BKK on Feb 5th was the best. Did not feel anything! Everyone was impressed in the cabin. Well done to the crew and pilots, although the look of the logo on the plane looks funny and cheap, I would not hesitate flying with them again.
reviews.author: Stephane Hong Kong

reviews.title: Cheap flights with adequate comfort
reviews.text: I enjoyed my flight. The staff was friendly, I had enough space for my legs (I'm 1.8m) and the food was okay.
reviews.author: Penschy

reviews.title: Best service in Europe
reviews.text: One of the last airlines in Europe that still offers drinks & snacks for free. Flight attendants always friendly, clean aircraft, boarding, departure and landing on time.
reviews.author: TravelJoeC1

reviews.title: No legspace but free sandwich and soft drink
reviews.text: I have never been flying with such small leg space before. Is there any rule for how tight the allowance is?
reviews.author: Nils W

reviews.title: NIce flight
reviews.text: The staff were very good and the seats were comfortable and very spacious, we were Even served food and a drink on a flight of just over 30 minutes
reviews.author: Dianne W

reviews.title: Neither budget nor full carrier
reviews.text: Had a good experience overall. Had to pay 60 Euro for excess baggage but the service on board was like a full class carrier with meal and drinks. Air hostess were extremely friendly and baggage claim was quick. Recommend travellers to plan baggage prior to travel and take the appropriate ticket to avoid extra charge at check in.
reviews.author: vijayagopal
